capabilities: Chat with AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini
Search in Google, Semantic Scholar, and vault-document retrieval modes
Render answers with clickable citation markers and a sources table
Insert chat answers into the active note as footnotes with a sources section
Set custom instructions applied to every message
extras: Plugin is in beta; prompts and selected note contents are sent to Logically's API, and the README warns against adding sensitive/private content. Free vs Unlimited plans gate which AI models are available. Google Sign-In is not yet available inside Obsidian. A community-plugin listing may not exist yet, so a direct beta install guide is provided.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run citation-backed AI research that combines web/academic search with the notes already in the vault.

relations.evidence: Use Logically’s AI Research Assistant directly inside Obsidian
The latest AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini.
All search modes, including Semantic Scholar Mode, Google Mode, and Document Retrieval Mode

requires.name: Unlimited plan for advanced and reasoning models

summary: Sidebar AI research assistant that answers questions with inline citations, searching the web and Semantic Scholar and using vault notes as sources.
